disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to maintain compliance with the laws of this state relating to workers' compensation insurance coverage

insurance_required.quote: Proof of (a) a certificate or policy of insurance written by an insurance carrier duly authorized to do business in this state which gives the effective dates of workers' compensation insurance coverage indicating that it is in force

citations.kind: revocation for failure to maintain insurance

definition_quote.value: Contractor means an individual, firm, partnership, limited liability company, corporation, or other association of persons engaged in the business of the construction, alteration, repairing, dismantling, or demolition of buildings, roads, bridges, viaducts, sewers, water and gas mains, streets, disposal plants, water filters, tanks and towers, airports, dams, levees and canals, water wells, pipelines, transmission and power lines, and every other type of structure, project, development, or improvement within the definition of real property and personal property

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
